summary:
Gümüşhane Province stands under the national framework of Turkey, which governs visitors to the province. The source inventory records no provincial legal divergence from that framework and no further Gümüşhane-specific finding, so the national assessment carried by the parent record applies to the province without local modification.

The province-specific material consists of two entries: a national-source entry that closes by confirming Gümüşhane diverges from no part of that frame, and an encyclopedia entry on the province itself that records nothing further of visitor relevance.
tangentialFactors: The single Gümüşhane-specific statement in the inventory is an absence: the national-source entry confirms the province conforms to the national frame rather than departing from it. No comparison with neighbouring provinces is sourced, and no per-province breakdown of policing, incidents or local regulation exists in the material, so the province cannot be ranked against others.
localsOnly: No resident-facing fact specific to Gümüşhane is recorded in the inventory. Matters that govern residents of the province rather than visitors are national in scope and are carried by the parent record.
outOfScopeNotes: Whether Gümüşhane applies any local ordinance on public gatherings, facilities or policing practice is unresolved: the inventory holds no provincial police reporting, no municipal regulation and no court decision from the province. The absence of a recorded divergence should not be read as evidence of local protection or local hostility; it reflects that no Gümüşhane-specific material beyond the confirmation of conformity with the national frame was sourced.
